parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Substitute and obtain 3-term quadratic $3u^2+4u-1=0$, or equivalent, e.g. $3(e^x)^2+4e^x-1=0$. [B1]
Solve a 3-term quadratic for $u$; it must be an equation with real roots. [M1]
Obtain root $(\sqrt7-2)/3$, or decimal in [0.21, 0.22]. Ignore second root, even if incorrect. [A1]
Use correct method for finding $x$ from a positive value of $e^x$; must see some indication of method, such as $x=\ln u$. [M1]
Obtain $x=-1.536$ only. CAO; must be 3 d.p. [A1] Total 5.
